registration_notes: Original logical reference canvas is 1024x1536. Approved face, front hair and clothing retain the original as their primary source; outer/arc rear strands also remain original overlays.
Facial generation inputs used reference crop [300,0,400,400] resized to 1200x1200; returned files are 1254x1254 and need measured registration.
All five source PNGs are RGB without an alpha channel. Painted checkerboard or green backgrounds are not transparency.

Body candidate contains a painted checkerboard; explicit source masks and registered hidden-hole fills are required. body-topwear-patch.json now contains only clothing hidden-fill and leg-edge corrections.

Rear-hair base uses the generated natural silhouette as one continuous source layer: source crop [0,100,1024,940] mapped to logical canvas x20,y90,w983,h846. Known-green automatic alpha extraction and green despill retain natural strand tips.

The rear-hair source_color_filter sets alpha to zero wherever G > B + 8 across the entire source layer, not only edges. It is specific to this pink/white plate with no intended green; other characters with green artwork require different measured masking. This preprocessing precedes independent upscaling of the cleaned alpha.

Original outer/arc rear strands overlay the generated base and move independently. Some visible rear-hair pixels now come from the generated base; an all-original-visible-rear-pixels claim is no longer accurate.
Original upper-lid folds are isolated as face_detail-upper-lid-folds, separate from thresholded moving dark lashes. The mouth_open layer is registered at logical y277 for this specific source.
Recorded prompts request visual constraints but do not establish that generated results satisfied them. Results and generated-service versions are recorded separately.

Original shallow pink brow ink is decomposed into three deterministic derivative PNGs by PrepareBrows.java; bright residuals and measured intersecting hair contours remain stationary. Foreground brow movement preserves the approved source design; this is not a newly generated face.

Viewer-left sleeve is a new registered continuous raster. Cuff overlay reuses identical geometry and source pixels; hands are isolated sprites. Existing relaxed hand is sampled from the original reference.

This release changes source art and atlas layout for the arm; a new neural 4x atlas was actually generated. Dynamics adapter unchanged-art flags describe only its own input-to-output operation, not the change from stage 2.
